title: Back in shape: two friends meet after the exams

script.text: Tom! Oh my goodness, is that really you? You look fantastic!
Ha, thanks, Kate! You should have seen me in March. I could hardly run for a bus.
Well, I got a gym membership as a birthday present from my parents, and honestly, I felt so out of shape that I decided to hit the gym three times a week.
Three times a week? Wow, that's impressive!

It was a disaster at first. In the second week I overdid it. I tried to lift the same weights as my cousin, and I pulled a muscle in my shoulder. I couldn't train for ten days, and I was so frustrated!
Oh no, poor you! Did you see a doctor?
Not exactly. My aunt is a physiotherapist, so she showed me a few exercises. Since then I always warm up properly. It takes about fifteen minutes, but it's definitely worth it.
That's so sensible. I never warm up. I just jump straight into running.
You really should! Anyway, the most important thing is a routine. I'm not a morning person at all, but I train before school, because if I leave it until the evening, I'll find a hundred excuses.
Ha, that's so true! I've been trying to get back into shape for months. I run twice a week, but I'm still out of breath after ten minutes.
Just give it time. It took me two months to build up some stamina. And push yourself a little! My trainer always says, "No pain, no gain."
Oh, I hate that saying! But OK, you've convinced me. Would you like to come for a run on Saturday?
I'd love to! Let's meet in the park at nine. Bring some water, and don't forget to warm up!
Yes, coach! See you on Saturday!

statements: Tom received his gym membership as a gift.
Tom's cousin has been going to the gym for many years.
Tom injured himself during his first week at the gym.
After injuring himself, Tom had to stop training for more than a week.
Tom finds it easier to train in the evening.
Kate has recently bought a gym membership.
Tom believes that you have to push yourself to make progress.
